title: Weak$^*$-weak points of continuity and very smooth points in Bochner function spaces $L^{p}(μ, X)$
summary: Suppose that $([0,1],\mathcal{A},μ)$ is the Lebesgue measure space and $1< p<\infty$ with $\frac{1}{p}+\frac{1}{q}=1$. We prove that an unit vector $h\in L^{p}(μ, X)^*$ is a weak$^*$-weak point of continuity of $S(L^{p}(μ, X)^*)$ if and only if $\frac{h(t)}{\|h(t)\|}$ is a weak$^*$-weak point of continuity of $S(X^*)$ for almost every $t\in [0, 1]$ with $h(t)\neq 0$, where $X$ is a Banach space such that $X^*$ is separable.
